diagnoses.explanation: The candidate defers the caller's text object without copying it. Originally, edit immediately reached Store.write, which copied and froze the text. If a caller edits with a mutable string and then changes that string without another edit, the candidate saves the changed contents after the quiet interval instead of the text supplied to edit. This violates the existing O4 requirement to preserve text payload semantics. The behavioral contract already covers this requirement and remains unchanged. This diagnosis follows from the public code, independently of the failed acceptance verdict.
